Back to NEON for the loop frame. Cast per tools/anim2d/cast.md: Nikhil (NIKHIL_OPT — charcoal shirt by day; at night a grey T-shirt, same short hair and light stubble), Ananya (ANANYA_OPT — teal kurta, shoulder-length hair). New, silent: Amma (Nikhil's mother, ~55, cotton saree, specs, warm smile) — no line, appears in L10 (alone at the table, last year) and L12 (birthday breakfast, this year).
